card.name: Inside capitalized brand drug names
card.fires_on: Partway through all-capital brand or drug names, on the middle piece after the first letters (e.g. DA|UR|ISMO, BR|IV|IACT). Also fires on pieces inside capitalized transliterated titles and hex-like IDs.

modes.label: Capitalized drug names
modes.description: Middle piece of an uppercase brand or generic drug name in label text.

modes.label: Other capitalized strings
modes.description: Middle piece of an uppercase transliterated title or a hex-style ID in web text.

card.writes: It promotes odd all-caps and code-like pieces and suppresses ordinary capitalized word starts like Re, Pr, Im, so it favors continuing an uppercase name.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of drug names written in capital letters, as the name is still being spelled out.
